description:
STATE (2026-08-31): the cells-at-name/arity design (edges as interface,
tagged classes as worklist, identity at settlement) was fully specified and
COLD-REVIEWED; verdict: DO NOT BUILD AS PROPOSED. This ticket records the
refutation and the re-entry conditions so the idea is neither re-derived nor
lost. The live campaign moves to the ascent census (fz-kdt.83) and the
correctness stories (fz-kdt.80, .76, .81).

## The refutation (all measured; recipes: fz2 build/interp debug, three
## target fixtures take_drop/range_map/predicate unless noted)

1. WORK MULTIPLIER, the decisive number: a cell evaluation re-walks every
   class (its read set is the union of its classes'). Evals would fall
   -53/-35/-64% while ROW-WALKS rise x2.64/x1.38/x2.39 OPTIMISTIC
   (1,740->4,588 / 312->430 / 1,284->3,063; pessimistic x11.8/x3.05/x12.4).
   The epic's tracked metric (evals) would improve while real work regressed
   -- the honest counter is body walks.
2. BLOWUP: classes/activations measured 1.58/1.07/1.34 (classes EXCEED
   activations; worst cells 69 and 42 distinct rows over 10 keys; worst edge
   54 input vectors -> 10 callee keys via closure-identity erasure). The
   only sound reading: class == canonical_activation_key(row) -- i.e.
   classes ARE today's keys and the cell is a container, not a new identity.
3. THE 2-CYCLE DOES NOT BREAK: caller cell reads ReturnRows(g,e) that callee
   cell publishes -- the same two-evaluator cycle under new fact names.
   Aggregation never manufactured it; interprocedural return flow does. What
   cells DO change: cycle membership becomes the static call graph (finite,
   fz-kdt.61) -- worth something, not 'multiplicative goes additive'.
   Stratification does not shorten intra-SCC ascent (single hot keys need
   >=25 rounds today; main/0 on predicate: 77 evals for one key).
4. TAG LIFECYCLE, fatal seam: no sound remap protocol exists. A caller
   reading a stale tag mid-remap consumes WRONG evidence (not low -- 'stale
   is not low'), welded permanently by the cumulative return join, invisible
   to zero-uncaused. Content-addressed append-only tags survive -- but are
   then value names: churn relocated, not eliminated. And {tag->row} isn't a
   function (337/30/203 coalesce events/drive: one callsite, many delivery
   paths per row). The engine's binary is_cumulative (drive.rs:130-132 ->
   scheduler.rs:537) cannot classify per-tag withdrawal: a third movement
   class = a new engine concept.
5. ARTIFACT-VS-PRECISION TENSION: today's abandoned rows are WALKED FOREVER
   (up to 16 rows under one key vs budget 8) and their analyses JOIN into
   published ReturnType and value_types (value_types merges column-wise
   across rows, jobs/semantic.rs:1073-1086, read by artifact/native).
   Deleting the abandoned population NARROWS the artifact -- 'delete the
   ~20%' and 'artifact must not move' are in direct tension. Ditto edges
   carrying pre-coalesce rows (fixing kdt.80/81 changes the demanded key
   set).
6. SYNTHETIC EDGES: root entry is clean (SeedRoot, one tag, write-once);
   the runtime-demand frontier is NOT an edge -- its minter is a PRODUCT
   (jobs/runtime_demand.rs:3089) and products may not publish facts; its
   discovery is post-settlement and re-opens minted cells. Second demand
   source, always (per fz-kdt.69's finding).
7. WRONG TARGET: ~79% of analysis evals are re-runs of SURVIVING keys, which
   this design multiplies rather than helps. Prior evidence the 79% is
   largely churn, not ascent: 870 zero-content-change completions on 00420;
   25 of main/0's 83 runs changing nothing.
8. STAGING failed the project's discipline: stages 1-2 unlandable (stage 1
   = an afternoon probe wearing a build's clothes; stage 2 ships a shim with
   no consumer) -- the 13.2-parking failure mode by construction.

## What survives, on the record
- Per-class derivation boundaries are CLEANER than 13.2's read-watermark (a
  class walk is a genuinely separate pass); if per-class incrementality is
  ever built, cells are its natural home.
- The transition protocol (below) is design-independent and governs whatever
  campaign runs next.
- The settlement grouping (canonical_activation_key over settled rows) is
  exact by construction -- reusable.

## RE-ENTRY CONDITION (all four, before cells are reconsidered)
(1) fz-kdt.76 fixed; (2) edges carry correlated rows (fz-kdt.81); (3)
per-class incrementality exists as one-derivation-per-class in the single
ledger so the read-set union does not coarsen evaluation; (4) fz-kdt.83's
census shows identity churn -- not round count -- dominates. Until (4), the
work multiplier stands and cells are a net regression.

## GRAVEYARD (kill reasons; do not re-walk)
settled-wait folds (ActivationInputs back-edge); cause-scoped mark_dirty
(wrong set); declared strata oracle (blind to completion-time reads/hidden
state); per-callsite contribution jobs (epidemic moves upstream);
finality-first pop (provably invariant); edge-derived demand over value keys
(edge strictly subsets stated demand; decommission non-terminating);
dispatch-class-keyed cells (rows migrate between classes mid-ascent -- the
cell identity itself churns); cells-with-tag-remap (this ticket, items 1-5).

## TRANSITION PROTOCOL (governs the successor campaign, unchanged)
1. The tree explains itself at every stage boundary; COLD NAVIGATOR drill
   between stages (fresh agent, repo+bw only; divergence -> fix the record).
2. One truth + derived shadow, never two truths; cutover = swap derivation
   direction behind a standing equivalence test.
3. Artifact constancy is the thread: canon byte-compare + inventory pins at
   every stage; only work-count claims may move numbers.
4. Scaffold inventory, CI-enforced (grep-gate); unlisted scaffolding fails.
5. Numbers carry recipes (lens/profile/fixture); re-triage at midpoint.
6. The graveyard stays in this ticket.
7. Ticket-first close-out; rewrite, never layer.
8. Each stage retires >=1 old mechanism or is explicitly ticketed
   scaffolding; park is a recorded outcome.
9. The loop is the vehicle (cold design review -> builder -> refuter).
10. Stacked draft PRs per stage.
title: Cell model refuted as proposed: work multiplier 2.4-2.6x; re-entry conditions recorded
